changed.title: Exact circuit cost on an affine basis of selectors and the sharp loss one gate below it
changed.statement:
∀ k m r : ℕ,
  let n := k+2*m+r
  let Circ := PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit
  let F := ZMod 2
  let legal := fun (width : ℕ) (C : Circ) =>
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack width C ∧
      (∀ h ∈ C.gates, h.inputs.length ≤ 2 ∧
        (h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or ∨ h.op = .mod 2 ∨ (h.op = .not ∧ h.inputs.length = 1)))
  let cost := fun (C : Circ) => C.gates.countP (fun h => @decide
    ((h.op = .and ∨ h.op = .or) ∧ h.inputs.length = 2) (Classical.propDecidable _))
  let bits := fun (width : ℕ) (u : Fin width → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin width => decide (u j = 1))
  let V := Fin n → F
  let S := Fin k → F
  let D := Fin m → F
  let Z := Fin r → F
  let base := 2*m+r
  ∀ (e : V ≃ₗ[F] S × (D × (D × Z))) (A : Fin m → S) (h : S → F),
    let word := fun (s : S) (i : Fin m) => dotProduct (A i) s
    let score := fun (C : Circ) (s : S) =>
      (∑ x : V, ∑ b : D, ∑ c : D, ∑ z : Z,
        let y := e.symm (s,(b,(c,z)))
        let v := dotProduct x y + h s + ∑ i, word s i * b i * c i
        if C.eval (bits n x ++ bits n y) = decide (v = 1) then (1 : ℝ) else -1) / 2^(n+base)
    let fits := fun (p : ℕ) (C : Circ) => legal (2*n) C ∧ cost C ≤ p
    ∀ (E : Finset S) (a : S), a ∈ E →
      let W := Submodule.span F (Set.image (fun s : S => s-a) (↑E : Set S))
      let d := Module.finrank F W
      let varying := ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i =>
        ∃ s ∈ E, word s i ≠ word a i)).card
      let price := base+d+varying
      let isolate := fun (u : S) => ∃ (i : Fin m) (v : F),
        ∀ s ∈ E, (word s i ≠ v ↔ s = u)
      let feasible := fun (p : ℕ) (b : ℝ) =>
        ∃ (N : ℕ) (C : Fin N → Circ) (w : Fin N → ℝ),
          (∀ i, fits p (C i) ∧ 0 ≤ w i) ∧ (∑ i, w i) = 1 ∧
          ∀ s ∈ E, b ≤ ∑ i, w i * score (C i) s
      0 < d → E.card = d+1 →
        (∀ p : ℕ, (∃ C : Circ, fits p C ∧ ∀ s ∈ E, score C s = 1) ↔ price ≤ p) ∧
        (∀ μ : S → ℝ, (∀ s ∈ E, 0 ≤ μ s) →
          let option := fun (v : ℝ) => (∃ u ∈ E, v = μ u) ∨
            ∃ (i : Fin m) (b : F), (∃ u ∈ E, word u i ≠ word a i) ∧
              v = (∑ s ∈ E, if word s i ≠ b then μ s else 0) / 2
          let loss := fun (C : Circ) => ∑ s ∈ E, μ s * (1-score C s)
          ∃ v : ℝ, option v ∧ (∀ w : ℝ, option w → v ≤ w) ∧
            (∀ C : Circ, fits (price-1) C → v ≤ loss C) ∧
            ∃ C : Circ, fits (price-1) C ∧ loss C = v) ∧
        (∀ b : ℝ, feasible (price-1) b → b ≤ 1-1/(2*(E.card : ℝ))) ∧
        (feasible (price-1) (1-1/(2*(E.card : ℝ))) ↔ ∀ u ∈ E, isolate u)
changed.unlocks: Prices a small set of tests and determines when random circuits attain the worst-selector bound one gate below perfect.
changed.context: A flat missing a test loses its weight. The hull of the other basis points can omit it alone. A flat covering the basis pays its dimension and must leave a varying column. Its mismatches lose half their weight. Delete all other varying columns to attain that option. The offset interpolates affinely on the basis. Uniformly weighted equality forces each profile to lose exactly half a unit at one test. All tests need equal shares of that loss. Mix one isolating column circuit per test for the converse. A cheaper perfect profile cannot exist by the dimension and column costs.

  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let a := 3*t
  let evenBit := fun (w : W) (i : Fin a) => mix w (ix (2*i.val))
  let next := fun (i : Fin a) => (⟨(i.val+1) % a, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos 2) ht)⟩ : Fin a)
  ∀ name c : W,
    let win := fun (spaced : Bool) (k : ℕ) =>
      ∃ (v : Fin h → Fin a → F) (A : ℕ → W →ₗ[F] W) (b : ℕ → W),
        let q := fun (i : Fin h) (w : W) => ∑ s, v i s * evenBit w s
        let live := fun (s : Fin a) => ∃ w : W, (∀ i, q i w = 0) ∧ evenBit w s ≠ 0
        let run := fun w : W =>
          (List.finRange h).foldl (fun u i => 2*u + (if q i w = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)

        (spaced = false → ∀ i w, q i w = mix w (ix (2*i.val))) ∧

changed.title: Two explicit costs determine all height and leaf budgets on an anchored cycle of parity blocks
changed.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℕ), 0 < b →
  let w := fun _ : Fin n => b
  let Raw := (i : Fin n) × Fin (w i)
  let parity := fun (y : Raw → Bool) (i : Fin n) =>
    decide (Odd ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (w i))).filter (fun j => y ⟨i,j⟩ = true)).card)
  let liftAx := fun (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)))
      (A : PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause Raw) =>
    ∃ C ∈ F, ∃ y : Raw → Bool, (∀ lit ∈ C, parity y lit.1 ≠ lit.2) ∧
      A = ((Finset.univ : Finset Raw).filter (fun b => b.1 ∈ C.image Prod.fst)).image
        (fun b => (b, !(y b)))
  let shape := fun (N J : Finset (List Bool)) =>
    [] ∈ N ∧ J ⊆ N ∧
    (∀ (p : List Bool) (b : Bool), p ++ [b] ∈ N → p ∈ J) ∧
    ∀ p ∈ J, p ++ [false] ∈ N ∧ p ++ [true] ∈ N
  let refutes := fun (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n))) (H K : ℕ) =>
    ∃ (N J : Finset (List Bool)) (line : List Bool → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause Raw),
      shape N J ∧ line [] = ∅ ∧ (∀ p ∈ N, p.length ≤ H) ∧ (N \ J).card ≤ K ∧
      (∀ p ∈ N \ J, liftAx F (line p)) ∧
      ∀ p ∈ J, PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsResolvent
        (line (p ++ [false])) (line (p ++ [true])) (line p)
  let base := 2^(b-1)
  let balanced := fun m : ℕ =>
    let d := Nat.clog 2 m
    (2^d-m)*base^(d-1) + (2*m-2^d)*base^d
  let atV := fun i : ℕ => (⟨i % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ : Fin n)
  let first := atV 0
  let last := atV (n-1)
  let F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause (Fin n)) := {C |
    C = {(last,true),(first,true)} ∨ C = {(last,false),(first,true)} ∨
      C = {(last,false),(first,false)} ∨
    ∃ i : ℕ, i+1 < n ∧ C = {(atV i,false),(atV (i+1),true)}}
  ∀ H K : ℕ, 2 ≤ n →
    Iff (refutes F H K)
      ((b*(1+Nat.clog 2 n) ≤ H ∧ base*(2*base + balanced n) ≤ K) ∨
       (b*Nat.clog 2 (n+3) ≤ H ∧ balanced (n+3) ≤ K))

changed.title: A small set of keys surviving early scheduled observations permits monotone exact counting through every later round
changed.statement:
∀ (k r d K : ℕ), 0 < k → d ≤ r →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (t rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range t).foldl (fun rowState rowIndex =>
      step (rowState ^^^ rot 1 rowState ^^^ rot (k - 1) rowState) ^^^
        rot (2 * rowIndex) rowKey ^^^ constant (rowIndex + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (t colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range t).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let V := Fin 7 × Fin k
  let P := V × Bool
  let keyLog := Nat.clog 2 (K+1)
  let B := 7*d+3
  let budget := 1048576*(k+1)^2*(K+1)^2*((k+1)*4^B+(r+1)+(keyLog+1)^2)
  let rounds := 128*(k+r+B+(keyLog+1)^2+1)
  let source := fun (a : P → Bool) =>
    [false,true] ++ List.ofFn (fun j : Fin (Fintype.card P) => a ((Fintype.equivFin P).symm j))
  let Gate := Bool × ℕ × ℕ
  let run := fun (G : List Gate) (a : P → Bool) =>
    G.foldl (fun (w : List Bool) g =>
      let l := w.getD g.2.1 false
      let r := w.getD g.2.2 false
      w ++ [if g.1 then l && r else l || r]) (source a)
  let N := 2 + Fintype.card P
  let depths := fun (G : List Gate) =>
    G.foldl (fun (w : List ℕ) g =>
      w ++ [max (w.getD g.2.1 0) (w.getD g.2.2 0) + 1]) (List.replicate N 0)
  ∃ (G : List Gate) (out : Fin (K+1) → ℕ), G.length ≤ budget ∧
    (∀ i : Fin G.length, (G.get i).2.1 < N+i.val ∧ (G.get i).2.2 < N+i.val) ∧
    (∀ j, out j < N+G.length ∧ (depths G).getD (out j) 0 ≤ rounds) ∧
    ∀ (u v : Fin k → Bool) (ρ : V → Option Bool),
      (∀ i, ρ (0,i) = some (u i) ∧ ρ (1,i) = some (v i)) →
      let bits := fun p : P => decide (ρ p.1 = some p.2)
      let word := fun (x : Fin k → Bool) => ∑ j : Fin k, (x j).toNat * 2^j.val
      let fits := fun (track : Fin 7) (x : ℕ) =>
        ∀ i : Fin k, ∀ b : Bool, ρ (track,i) = some b → x.testBit i.val = b
      let candidates := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : Fin k → Bool =>
        fits 2 (word x) ∧ fits 3 (first d (word x) (word u)) ∧
        fits 4 (second d (word x) (word v)))
      let accepted := candidates.filter (fun x =>
        fits 5 (first r (word x) (word u)) ∧ fits 6 (second r (word x) (word v)))
      (∀ j : Fin (K+1), (run G bits).getD (out j) false = true → accepted.card ≤ j.val) ∧
      (candidates.card ≤ K → ∀ j : Fin (K+1),
        (run G bits).getD (out j) false = true ↔ accepted.card ≤ j.val)

changed.title: Independent bits invisible to low slice moments on a single alternating ring
changed.statement:
∀ u t : ℕ,
  let n := t+1
  let m := u+1
  let I := Fin n
  let J := Fin (n+1)
  let V := Bool × I
  let P := V → Option Bool
  let S := Fin (2*n+1)
  let hist := fun (p : P) (r b : J) =>
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (V → Bool)).filter (fun x =>
      (∀ v, p v = none ∨ p v = some (x v)) ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i))).card = r.val ∧
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : I => x (false,i) ≠ x (true,i+1))).card = b.val)).card
  let profile := fun (H : J → J → ℕ) (h : ℕ) (s : S) =>
    ∑ r : J, ∑ b : J, if r.val+b.val = s.val then Nat.choose r.val h * H r b else 0
  ∀ mode : Bool,
    let k : ℕ := if mode then 1 else 0
    let need := if mode then 2*m*m+4*m else m*(m+1)
    need ≤ n →
    ∃ (enc : (Fin m → Bool) → P) (base : Fin m → ℚ) (readout : Fin m → S → ℚ),
      (∀ x, (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => (enc x v).isSome)).card =
        (if mode then 6*m else 3*m) + (if need < n then 1 else 0)) ∧
      (mode = false → ∀ x y v, (enc x v).isSome = (enc y v).isSome) ∧
      (∀ x y, ∀ h, h ≤ k → ∀ s, profile (hist (enc x)) h s = profile (hist (enc y)) h s) ∧
      ∀ x i, base i + (∑ s : S, readout i s * (profile (hist (enc x)) (k+1) s : ℚ)) =
        ((x i).toNat : ℚ)

changed.title: The accuracy budget for graph pigeonhole clause search under correlated sources with bounded neighboring mass ratios
changed.statement:
∃ C n₀ : ℕ, 2 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n →
  ∃ G : PEqualNP.Expanders.BipGraph (n+1) n,
    PEqualNP.Expanders.LeftDegLe G C ∧ PEqualNP.Expanders.RightDegLe G C ∧
    let V := PEqualNP.Expanders.GEdge G
    let X := V → Bool
    let e := Fintype.card V
    let F := PEqualNP.Expanders.funGraphPHP G
    ∀ (b T h R : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin b → ZMod 2)) (cap : (Fin b → ZMod 2) → ℕ),
      1 ≤ R → S.Nonempty → (∀ y ∈ S, 1 ≤ cap y) →
      let Y := Fin b → ZMod 2
      let flat := sSup {k : ℕ | ∃ (U : Submodule (ZMod 2) Y) (y : Y),
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2) U = k ∧ ∀ u ∈ U, y + u ∈ S}
      let B := min (∑ y ∈ S, cap y) (T + S.sup cap + flat)
      let L := Nat.clog 2 (R+1)
      let smooth := fun μ : X → ℝ => (∀ x, 0 ≤ μ x) ∧ 0 < ∑ x, μ x ∧
        ∀ x v, μ x ≤ (R : ℝ) * μ (Function.update x v (!(x v)))
      let possible := fun (allSources : Bool) => ∃ (H : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
          (pick : Fin b → Fin (2+e+H.size)) (out : Y → Finset (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)),
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (2+e) H ∧
        (∀ g ∈ H.gates, ((g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) ∧ g.inputs.length = 2) ∨
          g.op = .mod 2 ∨ (g.op = .not ∧ g.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
        H.gates.countP (fun g => @decide (g.op = .and ∨ g.op = .or) (Classical.propDecidable _)) ≤ T ∧
        (∀ y ∈ S, (out y).card ≤ cap y ∧ ∀ cl ∈ out y, cl ∈ F) ∧
        let msg := fun (x : X) (j : Fin b) =>
          let ws := H.wires ([false,true] ++ List.ofFn (fun i : Fin e => x ((Fintype.equivFin V).symm i)))
          ((ws.getD (pick j).val false).toNat : ZMod 2)
        (∀ x : X, msg x ∈ S) ∧
        let bad := Finset.univ.filter (fun x : X =>
          @decide (∀ cl ∈ out (msg x), PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.ClauseSat x cl) (Classical.propDecidable _))
        let accurate := fun μ : X → ℝ => (2 : ℝ)^h * (∑ x ∈ bad, μ x) ≤ ∑ x, μ x
        if allSources then (∀ μ, smooth μ → accurate μ) else (∃ μ, smooth μ ∧ accurate μ)
      (possible false → min (n*L) h ≤ C*L*B) ∧
      (C * min n ((R+1)^C*h) ≤ B → possible true)

changed.title: A supplied adaptive pair probe tree admits polynomial certification and optimal circuit fits at each transposition size
changed.statement:
let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]
let pairs := fun n : Nat => (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i =>
  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
let fast := fun g : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) g,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ solve : List Bool → List Bool, fast solve ∧
∀ (k : Nat) (crown : Bool), 2 ≤ k → (crown = true → 7 ≤ k) →
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  ∀ (hard : List ((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)))
    (soft : List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)),
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ ∀ h ∈ hard, f h.1 h.2 = crown
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let probe := fun f : Fn => (pairs k).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let vs := (pairs k).toFinset
  ∀ tree : List (List Bool × (Fin k × Fin k)),
  let keys := tree.map Prod.fst
  keys.Nodup → (∀ a e, (a,e) ∈ tree → e ∈ vs) →
  (∀ a bit, a ++ [bit] ∈ keys → a ∈ keys) →
  let atNode := fun (a : List Bool) => (tree.find? (fun r => decide (r.1 = a))).map Prod.snd
  let route := fun f : Fn => (List.range tree.length).foldl (fun a _ =>
    (atNode a).elim a (fun e => a ++ [decide (e ∈ probe f)])) ([] : List Bool)
  let good := ∀ a : List Bool, ∃ (b : Int) (w : Fin k × Fin k → Int), ∀ f : Fn,
    fits f → route f = a → (score f : Int) = b + (probe f).sum w
  let mask := fun S : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ S))
  let banks := fun z : (Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool) => List.ofFn z.1 ++ List.ofFn z.2
  let x := [crown] ++ header k ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap banks ++
    header soft.length ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => banks t.1 ++ [t.2]) ++ header tree.length ++
    tree.flatMap (fun t => header t.1.length ++ t.1 ++ header t.2.1.val ++ header t.2.2.val)
  let bits := fun z : Nat => (List.range (soft.length.log2+1)).map (fun j => z.testBit j)
  (good → ∃ slot : Fin (k/2+1) → List Bool,
    solve x = [true] ++ (List.finRange (k/2+1)).flatMap slot ∧
    ∀ s, let present := ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val
         (¬present → slot s = List.replicate (1+(pairs k).length+soft.length.log2+1) false) ∧
         (present → ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val ∧
           (∀ g : Fn, fits g → (probe g).card = s.val → score g ≤ score f) ∧
           slot s = [true] ++ mask (probe f) ++ bits (score f))) ∧
  (¬good → ∃ (a : List Bool) (P T : Finset (Fin k × Fin k)) (cube : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Fn),
    P = ((tree.filter (fun t => (t.1 ++ [true]).isPrefixOf a)).map Prod.snd).toFinset ∧
    Disjoint P T ∧ 2 ≤ T.card ∧
    (∀ U ⊆ T, fits (cube U) ∧ route (cube U) = a ∧ probe (cube U) = P ∪ U) ∧
    T.powerset.sum (fun U => (-1 : Int)^(T.card-U.card)*(score (cube U) : Int)) ≠ 0 ∧
    solve x = [false] ++ header a.length ++ a ++ mask P ++ mask T)

changed.title: Signed tests on optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions compile to one weighted matching polynomial with bounded edge activities
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let frame := fun j : Nat => j.bits.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
∃ write parity : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast parity ∧

∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))

    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
